## Case format
```json
{ "case_id": "PUB-01", "today": "2026-08-30",
  "borrowers": [ { "id": "B01", "name": "Rahima Begum", "group": "Shapla",
      "loan_bdt": "6375.00", "interest_bdt": "1125.00", "plan_weeks": 6, "instalment_bdt": "1250.00",
      "first_due": "2026-07-19",
      "payments": [ {"date": "2026-07-21", "amount_bdt": "312"}, ... ] }, ... ] }
```
Week k is due on `first_due` + 7 x (k - 1) days. Every plan satisfies `plan_weeks x instalment_bdt ==
loan_bdt + interest_bdt` exactly, so the plan itself is never a rounding question. All payments are dated
on or before `today`. Money strings are taka; results are integer paisa.
